completion.text: {"insufficient_evidence": false, "answer": "The pilot did not set the friction lock on the throttle before hand propping the engine, so after the engine started and the rpm increased, the airplane moved forward and struck the credit card machine. [20191230X15852:probable_cause][20191230X15852:analysis] The parking brake also malfunctioned: the airplane moved even with the brake applied, and the reason could not be determined.
